decisions.title: Santa Clara Avenue Speed Study
decisions.description: Studies Santa Clara Avenue from Linda Vista Avenue to Amherst Drive and finds none of the four NTMP criteria, below the minimum traffic-calming threshold.
processing_notes: Original City PDF reviewed: the December 2018 report states that the corridor meets none of the four NTMP criteria.
The existing R2 object has the same 1,431,467-byte size and MD5 ETag as the City original; public byte-identical validation is required before finalization.
